title: math Tools
goal: By the end of this lesson you will know some useful math module tools: sqrt, floor, ceil, and pi.
learn: floor and ceil for choosing the rounding direction
idea: math.sqrt(x) gives the square root. math.floor(x) rounds down, and math.ceil(x) rounds up. math.pi is the constant pi. These tools are handy in games, geometry, and score displays.
changeOneLine: In the editor above, change math.sqrt(49) to math.sqrt(9) and press Run. The first line should be 3.0.

practice.text: Import math. Print ceil(2.1) and floor(2.9).
practice.hint: First print math.ceil(2.1), which rounds up to 3. Then print math.floor(2.9), which rounds down to 2.

practice.text: Print a circle area for r=3 using math.pi, rounded to 2 decimals.
practice.hint: Finish area = math.pi * r * r (r is already 3). In print(), use round(area, 2) to get two decimal places.
practice.starterTip: area = math.pi * r * r then print(round(area, 2)), about 28.27.
practice.gradingNote: Pass if area uses pi*r*r and prints about 28.27.

quiz.question: What does math.floor(3.7) return?
quiz.wrong: It goes to the smaller whole number.

quiz.question: What does math.ceil(3.2) return?
quiz.wrong: It goes to the larger whole number.

quiz.question: Which gives a square root?
quiz.correct: Right, sqrt is the square root.
